The legacy system possessed no overwrite capability — it could only layer new regulations atop failing structures, increasing administrative mass without increasing institutional throughput.

The stoichiometric friction ratio of 0.5833 is inverted through protocol sequencing, meaning compensated transaction pathways now exceed uncompensated ones. Twelve protocols applied against seven bottlenecks creates a five-protocol surplus, ensuring redundant coverage so that no single vector can re-collapse into cascading failure.
